laws.rule: Terengganu's clothing etiquette guidelines for tourists, set by the State Entertainment, Cultural Performance and Sports department, are for Muslim visitors. In October 2023 the state's tourism executive councillor said non-Muslim tourists aren't obliged to follow them but should dress to suit the setting: swimwear is fine on resort islands but not in public places such as Pasar Besar Payang. He also said non-Muslims shouldn't drink alcohol openly in public areas, and that the state wasn't fining anyone under the guidelines.

sources.title: Non-Muslim tourists not tied to clothing etiquette in Terengganu (10 October 2023)
sources.supports: who the guidelines cover, the councillor's statements on dress and drinking in public

local-law.note: From a news report of the state government's statement; the guidelines themselves weren't read on a government page.
